title: Jug of Water
summary: Throw a single-use jug to create a permanent Water surface.

fields.Throw: Action. Throw up to 60 ft to create Water in a 7 ft radius. The surface is permanent until changed by an interaction.
fields.Water: Douses unprotected flames. Lightning turns it into Electrified Water and Cold turns it into Ice. A weapon dipped in Water loses its coating and Burning.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
